locked_conventions.plus_anchor: the deflated plus comparison has row dimension N only under the explicit nonzero projected-anchor hypothesis

locked_conventions.source_domain: H0_even consists of even L2 source functions with zero Lebesgue integral
locked_conventions.source_interval: [-lambda,lambda] with Lebesgue measure and zero extension; the physical interval is [lambda^(-1),lambda] with measure du/u
locked_conventions.source_normalization: c_(2j)=h_(2j)-(I_(2j)/I_0)*h_0 with unit-orthonormal h_j and I_j=integral h_j; arbitrary coordinate changes retain the source Gram

locked_formulas.coordinate_invariant_restriction: for source synthesis C, D=adjoint(C) @ C, W=T @ C, and F=ran(C), T @ P_F @ adjoint(T)=W @ D^dagger @ adjoint(W)
locked_formulas.finite_prefix_floor: for every fixed lambda>1 and finite X some non-effective mixed all-even prefix has norm(L_M)<=1/2 and W_M @ D_M^(-1) @ adjoint(W_M)>=(16*lambda^4)^(-1)*I_X; in the pinned coordinates W_M @ adjoint(W_M) dominates this whitened frame
locked_formulas.full_source_right_inverse: T=P_X*S_sigma*A_lambda has a right inverse B_X with norm(B_X)<=sqrt(2)*lambda*M_mu(lambda)
locked_formulas.normalized_tail: R=T @ adjoint(T), Z=R^(-1/2) @ T, L_F=Z @ (I-P_F) @ adjoint(Z), and T @ P_F @ adjoint(T)=R^(1/2) @ (I-L_F) @ R^(1/2)
locked_formulas.prolate_source_gram: for C_M=(c_2,...,c_(2M)), D_M=adjoint(C_M) @ C_M=I+v @ adjoint(v) with v_j=I_(2j)/I_0
locked_formulas.relative_floor: T @ P_F @ adjoint(T)>=gamma*R iff norm(L_F)<=1-gamma for 0<gamma<=1
locked_formulas.unbuffered_matched_obstruction: at N=m the unbuffered r_plus=r_minus=m-2 force row nullity at least two in both sectors
